excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]的行星环境改造过程中，意外发现了大量埋藏在地表冰层中的本土生物。更令人惊讶的是，这些生物竟然仍然存活。

该物种似乎正处于一种异常深度的冬眠状态，这是它们应对[From.GetName]漫长冰河期的有效生存策略。然而，星球改造过程中的解冻现象提前结束了它们的休眠状态。

从冰封的沉睡中苏醒后，这些生物已经展现出初步的智慧迹象，并在觅食过程中使用简单的工具。

它们将立即被消灭。我们将把产生的生物质用于我们自己的目的。

texts.en:
Our terraforming efforts on [From.GetName] revealed a surprising number of native fauna buried within the surface ice. Even more astonishing is that these creatures are somehow still alive. 

The species appears to have been in the midst of an exceptionally deep hibernation; an effective method for surviving [From.GetName]'s lengthy ice ages. Thawing caused by the terraforming process has prematurely brought their stasis to an end.

Roused from their icy slumber, the creatures are already demonstrating glimpses of intelligence, utilizing simple tools in their food-gathering efforts.

They will be exterminated without delay. We will harvest the resulting biomass for our own purposes.

texts.zh:
对[event_target:hibernator_planet.GetName]上的欠智慧生物种群的研究揭示了其非凡的休眠模式。这种模式由一种特定的酶调控，该酶触发了生物体进入和退出深度休眠状态的过程。在这种状态下，其体内的化学反应几乎降至可忽略不计的程度。

我们提取了这种酶，并成功通过镇静化合物将其应用于其他多种生物。在所有案例中，原本不具备休眠能力的物种都能够进入长时间的休眠状态，在此期间细胞老化显著减缓。

这一非凡的突破为人工增强的冷冻休眠铺平了道路，将大大减轻有机物种在长距离太空旅行中的身体负担。
texts.en:
Studies of the pre-sapient population on [event_target:hibernator_planet.GetName] produced insights into their remarkable hibernation patterns. They are regulated by a particular enzyme which triggers the body's entry into and exit from deep stasis sleep. In this state, chemical reactions within their bodies are reduced to almost negligible amounts.

We extracted this enzyme and have been able to administer it successfully - via sedative compound - to various other organisms. In all cases, species previously incapable of hibernation were able to enter into a lengthy dormancy which significantly reduced cell aging for its duration.

This extraordinary breakthrough paves the way for artificially-enhanced cryosleeps that will greatly reduce the physical strains of long distance space journeys for organic species.
